item.title: Salt shortage or supply surge? Cargill responds as Cleveland demand answers
item.description: Cargill tells News 5 it does not have a shortage of salt supplies but says early winter weather led to a surge in demand that its workforce is working overtime to meet.

item.title: MAGNET named regional job hub despite layoffs amid funding freeze
item.description: Cleveland's Manufacturing Advocacy and Growth Network, or MAGNET, will be one of seven regional job hubs under the state's new WorkOhio Program.

item.title: Boston Mills Brandywine Resort prepares for busy weekend thanks to fresh snow
item.description: As Boston Mills Brandywine Resort prepares for what they believe will be a busy weekend, General Manager Jake Campbell said his staff will be ready and have plenty of room for skiers to stay warm.
